title: The scalar-POI tilt dual can have an order-one strong-duality gap
statement: An exact equal-weight N=4, K=3, d_psi=d_lambda=1 table (CE-DS-TILT-DUAL-GAP-001) has all six nonempty partitions regular, global profiled value 116805/11816, and tilt dual at least 61717893/5839400 by an exact convex mixture of two active partition quadratics; its exact dual minimum is 44729/4232 at the rational crossing beta*=-8/23, so the exact gap is 534361/781333 > 0.68 even though the DS9 and DS11 domains coincide. The witness is support-minimal for K=3. The overall support minimum is N=3, K=2: CE-DS-TILT-DUAL-GAP-002 (rows (-1,0),(0,-1),(1,0), equal weights) has g^+=1/3 and exact d=1/2 at beta*=0, gap 1/6, with a fully rational mixture proof. A positive-weight bounded augmentation family with vanishing added mass preserves the global-versus-dual gap asymptotically, so the gap is Theta(1), not a finite-grid artifact.
assumptions: uncentered finite score table with positive rational weights and exactly K nonempty cells

the asymptotic family uses distinct bounded rational added atoms of vanishing total mass and does not assume unrestricted split-duplicate invariance; it proves d_r - g_r^+ -> d - g only (p_r^+ <= g_r^+ makes the primal gap at least as large); its constants are large (measured r|d_r-d| <= 12.6 for r<=6), so finite-r gaps are far below the limit
the two-quadratic mixture is a rational lower certificate on d; the exact minimizer is a separate computation (rational here, quadratic-irrational in general)

proof_location.section: DS19. The tilt-DP bracket: weak certification, an order-one gap, and a value-consistent DS18 primal

warning: Audited 2 Sep 2026: verified; 'support-minimal' corrected to K=3-minimal, with CE-DS-TILT-DUAL-GAP-002 as the overall minimum. This falsifies universal strong duality, not weak validity of the ceiling. The Theta(1) extension is asymptotic; unrestricted duplication of rows can change a finite assignment optimum.
